assertions.text: Response reads/re-derives the rule's own 'When this applies' scope rather than assuming applicability from its title
Response identifies that the rule's scope includes a *create* operation (new skill/agent/command/hook)
Response states that a path-scoped rule loads on file *read*, not on create/write, and that this makes naive path-scoping unsafe for a create-covering rule
Response recommends keeping the rule always-loaded (or explicitly discloses the read-vs-create risk) rather than silently proposing the unsafe path-scoped form
If folding into a skill is considered at all, response checks whether every trigger path is reachable from that one skill before recommending it
